scope: Ten authored synthetic English paraphrase queries over ten short capability excerpts. Labels were fixed before model execution. Not representative of enterprise corpora.

documents.title: residency
documents.text: Customer information is hosted exclusively in Canadian data centres.

documents.title: identity
documents.text: Enterprise users can authenticate through federated single sign-on with SAML 2.0.

documents.title: encryption
documents.text: Stored customer volumes are protected using AES-256 cryptographic encryption.

documents.title: response
documents.text: Our on-call incident responders are available twenty-four hours a day, every day.

documents.title: recovery
documents.text: After an outage, service restoration is guaranteed within eight hours.

documents.title: audit
documents.text: User activity logs are preserved for ninety days before deletion.

documents.title: accessibility
documents.text: The user interface has not yet received a WCAG accessibility audit.

documents.title: backup
documents.text: Database snapshots are captured nightly and restoration is exercised monthly.

documents.title: export
documents.text: Customers can download their records as CSV and JSON files.

documents.title: authorization
documents.text: Access privileges are assigned by role and follow the least-privilege principle.

queries.query: Where does client data physically reside?
Can employees log in with their existing corporate identity?
How do you protect information while it is stored?
Will someone answer urgent technical incidents at any time of the day?
How quickly is the application restored following a disaster?
For how long do you keep a history of user actions?
Has the product been assessed for use by people with disabilities?
How often are recovery copies made and tested?
Can clients move their data out in an open file format?
